instruction_text: Analyze where purchase requisitions spend the most time waiting for approval from January 1 through March 31, 2025. Report median approval waiting time and end-to-end cycle time, and break the results down by department and approval step. Include only requisitions with a value above 10,000 USD.
Compare order throughput and median end-to-end cycle time across fulfillment sites for the last 90 days. Exclude canceled orders and segment the comparison by fulfillment site and sales channel.
